question.en: Given that 122 0.86 = x, 122 0.22 = y and x z = y 7 , then the value of z is close to:
question.hi: यदि दिया गया है कि 122 0.86 = x, 122 0.22 = y और x z = y 7 है , तो z का सन्निकट मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **1.79** ($z = 1.7907 \approx 1.79$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 122! Directly equate exponents: $0.86z = 0.22 \times 7 = 1.54 \Rightarrow z = 1.54 / 0.86 \approx 1.79$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 122 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.86z = 0.22 \times 7 \Rightarrow z \approx 1.79$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 122^{0.86}$ and $y = 122^{0.22}$ into $x^z = y^{7}$:
$122^{0.86z} = 122^{0.22 \times 7} = 122^{1.54}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.86z = 1.54 \Rightarrow z = \frac{1.54}{0.86} = 1.7907 \approx \mathbf{1.79}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.22 : 0.86 = 11 : 43$ ⇒ $z = \frac{11 \times 7}{43} = 77/43 \approx \mathbf{1.79}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 122^{0.86}$ व $y = 122^{0.22}$ को $x^z = y^{7}$ में रखें:
$122^{0.86z} = 122^{1.54} \Rightarrow 0.86z = 1.54 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{1.79}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.22 \times 7}{0.86} \approx \mathbf{1.79}$।
